newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sagem awaits Thomson details - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sagem awaits Thomson details - paper.

text.p: French electronics company Sagem is waiting for details of how the government intends to privatise defence electronics group Thomson-CSF before commenting on the issue, Sagem chairman Pierre Faure told a newspaper on Tuesday.

Faure, asked by Le Figaro in an interview whether he was interested in Thomson-CSF, said, "We are waiting for the new rules from the government for the Thomson-CSF privatisation." He added that Sagem is the second biggest civilian and military electronics company in France.

The French government has said it plans to announce details of the Thomson-CSF privatisation early in the new year, following a suspension of the process due to an objection by the Privatisation Committee to the sale of Thomson SA to Lagardere Groupe.

Thomson-CSF chairman Marcel Roulet and the company's executive committee are lobbying for a market flotation but Lagardere head Noel Forgeard wants to press ahead with a private sale to his own group.
